Simply known as the '''Resistance shuttle''', the craft was used by the [[Resistance]] in the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. Three of these [[shuttle]]s were used by [[Jade Squadron|Jade]] and [[Ace Squadron]]s when [[Blockade of Dantooine|rescuing]] Resistance recruits from [[Dantooine]]. While evacuating Dantooine, however, [[Shuttle two (Resistance)|one]] [[shuttle]] was destroyed by the [[First Order]].<ref name="Rebuilding" />
